pages.text: The $(item)Mace$() is made from a $(item)Heavy Core$() and a $(item)Breeze Rod$(). Hit something while falling and the harder you fall, the harder you hit. It also cancels your fall damage.$(br2)$(thing)Density$() adds to the smash, $(thing)Breach$() pierces armour, and $(thing)Wind Burst$() bounces you back up.
A $(item)Wind Charge$() bursts into a gust that pushes everything away, you included. Throw one at your feet to leap.
$(item)Spears$() charge: sprint at a target and the hit grows with your speed. $(thing)Lunge$() makes the charge longer.
